method: Retrospective, mechanism-stratified holdout authored without looking at either ranker's output. Public cases cover synchronization, resources, pipelines and vertex input, with two same-domain timing controls where a normative rule does not diagnose the issue. Earlier evaluation origins were excluded. A hit requires an exact frozen file, revision, license and location within the first five matches on the same index. Adjacent fence and semaphore clauses are distinct decoys. Any negative-case result requires manual review. Some original authors state the answer or include a spec URL, so this evaluates diagnostic lookup and localization, without measuring novel transfer, ecosystem-wide quality, historical latency or adoption.

cases.title: Vulkan validation errors in wgpu 0.30.0: VUID-vkAcquireNextImageKHR-fence-10066
cases.mechanism: The acquire fence is still associated with an unfinished queue command.
cases.decision: Trace completion of the fence's previous queue command before reuse.

sources.note: The clause requires completion before fence reuse.

cases.title: `wgpu_hal::Vulkan::swapchain::native::SwapchainAcquireSemaphore::acquire` is never awaited if no commands are submitted that use its texture
cases.mechanism: Dropping an acquired texture without submitting work leaves an acquire semaphore signaled.
cases.decision: Ensure every successful acquire has a consuming wait before reusing its binary semaphore.

sources.note: The clause requires an unsignaled acquire semaphore.

cases.title: Texture format misreporting tracking issue
cases.mechanism: The capability report permits an R64_UINT image usage the device rejects; the separate NV12 report combines plane aspects.
cases.decision: Query the exact R64_UINT image-format tuple before exposing usage, or create separate views for each NV12 plane.

sources.note: Check that the image creation limits are defined for the selected tuple.
Use at most one multi-planar aspect bit for the independent NV12 report.

cases.title: Spurious validation error messages about missing multisample state
cases.mechanism: A pipeline reported as missing multisample state supplies it while rasterization state is dynamic.
cases.decision: Inspect pMultisampleState and fragment-output requirements separately from the nullable pRasterizationState.

sources.note: Fragment-output requirements concern pMultisampleState and dynamic-state exceptions.

cases.title: MoltenVK segfaults in `vkCmdBindVertexBuffers`/`vkCmdBindVertexBuffers2` when a buffer is `VK_NULL_HANDLE`
cases.mechanism: The application binds a null vertex buffer when nullDescriptor is disabled.
cases.decision: Gate binding on nullDescriptor or use a legal fallback buffer. Graceful failure would be a robustness improvement.

sources.note: The rule disallows null pBuffers entries when nullDescriptor is disabled.
The same feature condition applies to the second binding entry point.

cases.title: wgpu-hal v26.0.6 PR #8420 fence wait blows up acquire latency on AMD + Immediate present (bisect + reproducer)
cases.mechanism: A bisected acquire-fence wait increases latency under Immediate present on AMD.
cases.decision: Start with the same-repository bisect and controlled timing. A generic normative fence rule does not explain the regression.

cases.title: [AMD Vulkan driver] vkQueuePresentKHR blocks ~100ms per call → D3D9 via DXVK locked at 10 FPS (RX 9070 XT, 2.0.395)
cases.mechanism: Driver-side present/acquire calls stall on an AMD D3D9 translation workload without a concrete validity violation.
cases.decision: Start from the driver environment and timing reproducer. A generic WSI rule has no observed validity violation to explain.
